title: Protect playback during a delivery failure
description: Choose the playback phase, inject a media-path failure, and select a response. The model shows whether the player has enough buffer and whether the response protects the origin.

phases.label: Steady playback
phases.detail: The player has a normal safety buffer.

phases.label: Seek
phases.detail: A viewer jumps to an uncached position.

failures.label: Edge miss storm
failures.detail: Many viewers request the same cold segments.

failures.label: Regional CDN outage
failures.detail: The assigned provider cannot serve manifests or segments.

failures.label: Corrupt segment
failures.detail: A referenced object fails integrity or decode checks.

failures.label: Origin overload
failures.detail: Miss traffic has exhausted the origin safety budget.

responses.label: Retry the origin
responses.detail: Every player retries the original route.

responses.label: Bounded CDN failover
responses.detail: Freeze retries, preserve buffer, and move to a measured healthy route.

responses.label: Coalesce at origin shield
responses.detail: One upstream fill serves many simultaneous edge misses.

responses.label: Restore previous publication
responses.detail: Revoke the bad manifest and return to the last validated version.

responses.label: Serve a lower rendition
responses.detail: Reduce segment bytes while the media path recovers.
